purpose: Freeze the minimum normal Linux-visible device model for unchanged systemd-udevd on the selected QEMU profile.

required_visibility: device identity projected in sysfs as required by oracle
no extra authority from node existence
sysfs block projection required by udev
normal device node for selected root/block path

reference_cases.operation: start unchanged Debian systemd-udevd under normal systemd service path
enumerate console + selected VirtIO block + selected VirtIO NIC through ordinary udev path
where QEMU/runtime profile supports controlled remove/re-add, verify generation-safe teardown/reprobe
reference_cases.classification: mandatory only for devices/profile where safe hotplug is selected for Step 38

reference_cases.expected_class: bounded failure/no kernel panic/no authority amplification

projection_rules: sysfs device facts come from canonical hardware/driver owners
device node creation/lookup never grants authority beyond canonical owner
device removal revokes stale IRQ/DMA/FD/device generation authority before reuse
